other_conditions: Child of parents sentenced to death or life imprisonment
Child of a widowed mother receiving a pension (maximum three children at a time)
Child of HIV/AIDS affected mother or father
Child of parents suffering from leprosy
Child of related mothers (maximum three children at a time)
Child of divorced or abandoned women receiving a pension
Child of parents suffering from silicosis
Child must be under 18 years; if 18 and still studying, benefit extended up to 19 years
Guardian must be a native of Rajasthan or have resided in the state for more than three years
Guardian family income must not exceed Rs 1.20 lakh per annum
benefits_summary: Monthly cash assistance of Rs 1500 (age 0‑6) or Rs 2500 (age 6‑18) for orphans, and Rs 500 or Rs 1000 respectively for other eligible children, plus an annual Rs 2000 for educational material.
